name: Engineering Ship
description: Sync with base branch, run tests, review the diff, commit, push, and create a PR.

baseBranch.description: Base branch to merge into (defaults to main/develop)

nodes.name: Check current state
nodes.description: Check git status, current branch, and what's changed since the base branch. Understand what is about to ship.

nodes.name: Sync with base branch
nodes.description: Fetch and merge the base branch into the current branch. Resolve any conflicts.

nodes.name: Run tests
nodes.description: Run the full test suite. Do not continue if tests fail.

nodes.name: Review the diff
nodes.description: Review the diff for dead code, missing error handling, security issues, and stale comments. Flag anything that needs human judgment before shipping.

nodes.name: Commit and push
nodes.description: Stage all changes, create a single-line conventional commit, and push to remote.

nodes.name: Create pull request
nodes.description: Open a PR to the base branch with a clear title and summary of what changed and why.
